english.meaning: to let hot food or drink cool
english.note: 唔使攤 means no need to let it cool.

exampleSentences.english: But I think it goes down easier cold, so no need to let it cool.
exampleSentences.traditional: 但係我就覺得凍就易入口啲囖，唔使攤。
